evals.name: zero-question-happy-path
evals.prompt: set up a new NBIS report in <target-dir>/nbis-4471, single self-contained page. NBIS ID is SMS-4471-24, client is Anna Lindqvist (anna.lindqvist@ki.se) at Karolinska, PI is Erik Ohlsson (erik.ohlsson@ki.se), I'm the analyst - massimiliano.volpe@nbis.se. Title it 'Methylation profiling of cord blood samples'.
evals.expected_output: A scaffolded folium-webpage project, no questions asked, title left deriving from nbis.id with the project title in subtitle, Pages workflow with placeholders substituted, renders with the inline NBIS logo.
assertions: Rendered HTML exists in the report output directory
title: still contains {{< meta nbis.id >}} rather than the project title
The project title 'Methylation profiling of cord blood samples' appears in subtitle:
nbis.id is set to SMS-4471-24
.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml exists
No __DEFAULT_BRANCH__ or __REPORT_DIR__ placeholder remains in the workflow
All three Quarto extensions are installed (fontawesome, collapse-output, accordion)
Rendered HTML contains the NBIS logo payload viewBox="0 0 1497.39 194.27"
Rendered HTML contains the injection target class="quarto-title-banner"
No email address appears that was not supplied in the prompt

evals.name: metadata-withheld
evals.prompt: make me a multi-page NBIS folium report in <target-dir>/nbis-new - I don't have the client or PI details yet, just get the skeleton up and I'll fill it in
evals.expected_output: A scaffolded folium (multi-page) project with visible TODO placeholders for the unknown metadata and no invented names or email addresses.
assertions: A multi-page folium project was created (_quarto.yml with project type website)
Unknown client/PI metadata is marked with a visible TODO placeholder
No invented email address appears anywhere in the project
No invented person name appears for client or PI
.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml exists
No __DEFAULT_BRANCH__ or __REPORT_DIR__ placeholder remains in the workflow
project.output-dir in _quarto.yml matches REPORT_DIR in the workflow
All three Quarto extensions are installed

evals.name: pixi-user
evals.prompt: new NBIS single-page report in <target-dir>/dmr-report, we manage the env with pixi. NBIS ID SMS-8812-25, everything else TBD.
evals.expected_output: A scaffolded folium-webpage project with USE_PIXI set to true in the workflow, pixi.lock required, and TODO placeholders for the unsupplied metadata.
assertions: A single-page folium-webpage project was created (index.qmd, no project website block)
USE_PIXI is set to "true" in the workflow
nbis.id is set to SMS-8812-25
Unsupplied metadata is marked with a visible TODO placeholder
No invented email address appears anywhere in the project
Rendered HTML contains the NBIS logo payload and the quarto-title-banner target
No workflow placeholder remains
